scope: POST_V1 static optical-property translation contract only. No renderer execution, solver science, protected-result opening, Level-B mutation, Taylor/Jerusalem tuning, or epsilon substitution.

source.zeroLayerTauSign: negative zero retained as source provenance metadata

renderer.name: Eradiate
renderer.kernelMediumSerialization: sphericalcoordsvolume wrapping nearest-filtered float32 gridvolume for sigma_t/albedo
renderer.analyticPhase: HenyeyGreensteinPhaseFunction; g is the asymmetry parameter emitted directly to the kernel

rejectedDirect49CellMapping.reason: Eradiate v1.0.1 spherical heterogeneous-medium serialization supplies an N-value nearest-filtered float32 radial grid through a global spherical-coordinate transform and does not encode the V31 nonuniform native z-coordinate array. Feeding the 49 source rows directly would therefore replace the native 1.0/2.5/5.0 km layer widths by 49 equally spaced radial cells and is not translation-parity preserving.

commonLattice.mappingRule: For source layer i, repeat its properties on every 0.5-km cell whose interval lies inside [z_lo_i,z_hi_i].

implementationPlan.class: narrow Deep-only LayeredHGAtmosphere derived from AbstractHeterogeneousAtmosphere
implementationPlan.sigmaT: Decode source binary32 tau_i exactly, divide in float64 by exact source width dz_i in km, then let the Eradiate kernel-required float32 VolumeGrid cast produce the frozen kernel coefficient for every mapped 0.5-km subcell.
implementationPlan.albedo: Copy each source binary32 SSA value to every mapped subcell; its float32 kernel representation is bit-exact with the source word.
implementationPlan.phase: Create analytic HG components for the unique source g words and use deterministic one-hot per-cell BlendPhaseFunction weights; source g words are exactly reproducible by float32 kernel representation. In exact-zero-scattering cells all component weights are zero and phase choice is physically inactive.
implementationPlan.zeroSemantics: The three upper source negative-zero tau layers remain exact zero optical coefficients. Retain signed-zero source words separately as provenance; never replace zero by epsilon.

staticNumericAudit.straightChordBoundFormula: sum_i abs(float32(tau_i/dz_i)-tau_i/dz_i) * 2*sqrt((R+z_hi_i)^2-(R+z_lo_i)^2), with R=6378.1 km; a ray segment through a shell cannot exceed the full tangent chord used by this sum bound.
staticNumericAudit.boundScope: Representation/straight-ray optical-depth and direct-transmission bound only; not a theorem bounding full multiple-scattered radiance error.

separateBlocker: V34 Korkin Table 9(a) normalization provenance still has one unresolved publication-side multiplicative export bridge; this V35 translation contract does not weaken or bypass that fail-closed gate.

Before any render, assert 0.5-km lattice coverage, source-word decoding, frozen sigma32/AOD error values and bounds, bit-exact SSA/g float32 roundtrips, exact zero preservation, and one-hot HG phase weights.
